inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Requirements during probation: Per the probation conditions a missing enrollment information wasn't obtained. within the required timeframe.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements during probation (26 TAC §745.8641)

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Medical Authorization: 1 child enrolled at the operation didn't have authorization for emergency medical care listed on their enrollment form.  The parent was contacted and sent the enrollment form to complete.  This was corrected today at inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Physician Information (26 TAC §746.605(11))

occurrences.finding: Field Trips - Children Identified with Center: The daycare is currently providing field trips.  The daycare didn't have their telephone information listed on what the children wear as required for field trips.  This was corrected at inspection by printing out landyards for the children to wear on their upcoming field trip.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Field Trips - Children Identified with Center (26 TAC §746.3001(6))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Animals: Operational policies were reviewed.  The daycare didn't have listed that they have ducks at the center.  Information about the ducks was added to the policies and this was corrected at inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Animals (26 TAC §746.501(a)(17))

occurrences.finding: Field Trips - Emergency Medical Forms: The daycare needs to add emergency medical care authorization to required paperwork for field trips.  These were being printed and added to the field trip binders.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Field Trips - Emergency Medical Forms (26 TAC §746.3001(2))

occurrences.finding: Requirements during probation: Information was obtained for to child admission files within 5 days as required by the operation's probation terms.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements during probation (26 TAC §745.8641)

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact: 1 child needs an address for their listed emergency contact on the admission form.  The parent was contacted by phone and this information was provided.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact (26 TAC §746.605(6))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - School Information for School-age Child: 1 child needs  the name and phone number for the name of the school a school age child attends.  The parent was contacted by phone and this information was provided.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Special Needs Statement (26 TAC §746.605(13))

occurrences.finding: Requirements during probation: The operation didn't use the child record evaluation form to evaluated the new child files per the probation conditions.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements during probation (26 TAC §745.8641)

occurrences.finding: Administering Medication - Original Container with Child's Name, Date: A child's epi-pen isn't in it's original container.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Administering Medication - Original Container with Child's Name, Date (26 TAC §746.3805(b)(1))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days: An infant didn't have updated infant feeding instructions.  Updated infant feeding instructions was provided by the parent during today's inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: 4 child files for children recently enrolled were reviewed during today's inspection.  One child didn't have the required immunization record.  The parent was able to provide a copy of the immunization record during today's inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Requirements during probation: The operation didn't obtain the required missing enrollment information with-in the required 5-days as required by the operation's probation conditions.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements during probation (26 TAC §745.8641)

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact: 1 child admission form needs someone other than parent to be listed for emergency contact and 1 child needs a physical address to be listed for emergency contact.  This was corrected at inspection by contacting the parents to provide the necessary information.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact (26 TAC §746.605(6))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Electrical Outlets Covered: Two outlets in the infant room that were accessible didn't have outlet covers.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Electrical Outlets Covered (26 TAC §746.3701(1))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Animals: The operation needs to add information to their operational policies notifyng the parents that there are chickens at the operation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Animals (26 TAC §746.501(a)(17))

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements - Child's Food Allergy Plans: A food allergy list wasn't posted in the kitchen as required.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements - Child's Food Allergy Plans (26 TAC §746.403(b))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: Sanitzing spray was sprayed on a table while an infant was sitting at the table drinking from a cup and left on the table in the reach of the child.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Nutrition and Food Service - Follow Meal Patterns: Lunch was observed during today's inspection.  Lunch served today didn't meet five required components.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Nutrition and Food Service - Follow Meal Patterns (26 TAC §746.3301(b))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Emergencies: Operational policies were reviewed during today's inspection.  The operation doesn't have procedures on how medical emergencies will be handled in their policies.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Emergencies (26 TAC §746.501(a)(5))

occurrences.finding: AP Infants Sleep on Backs or Must Have Completed and Signed Sleep Exception Form for the Infant: This standard was reviewed for this investigation.   Based on the information received during the investigation, an infant younger than twelve months of age was sleeping in a crib on their stomach.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Infants Sleep on Backs or Must Have Completed and Signed Sleep Exception Form for the Infant (26 TAC §746.2427)

occurrences.finding: AP Initial background checks submitted - At the time you hire someone: A teacher in the toddler classroom in direct contact with children. doesn't have the requied background check.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Initial background checks submitted - At the time you hire someone (26 TAC §745.621(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Caregiver Qualification Age Exemption Attends High School - Enrolled in Child-care Career Program Approved by TEA/TEPSAC: A staff member under 18 years of age doesn't meet the caregiver qualification that attends high school.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Caregiver Qualification Age Exemption Attends High School - Enrolled in Child-care Career Program Approved by TEA/TEPSAC (26 TAC §746.1109(b)(3)(A))

occurrences.finding: Caregiver Qualification Age Exemption Attends High School - Not in Charge of Group: A staff member under the age of 18 doesn't meet the caregiver requirement.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Caregiver Qualification Age Exemption Attends High School - Not in Charge of Group (26 TAC §746.1109(b)(1))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: A teacher in the toddler 1 classroom was observed across the hall at the door of another classroom leaving her class unattended.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Animals at Center - No Contact with Chickens, Ducks, Reptiles: It was observed during today's follow up that the children were playing on an outdoor play area while chickens were walking around the play area.  This was corrected at inspection by staff rounding up the chickens and moving the children to another play area.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Animals at Center - No Contact with Chickens, Ducks, Reptiles (26 TAC §746.3905(a))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check determination - If ineligible then you must immediately remove subject from operation and confirm to CBCU receipt of notice letter: Owner was present at the operation today after being notified that she isn't allowed to be present.  The owner had to be instructed to leave the facility.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check determination - If ineligible then you must immediately remove subject from operation and confirm to CBCU receipt of notice letter (26 TAC §745.635(2))

occurrences.finding: Complying with Laws and Rules: The operation isn't complying with the safety plan put in place during a current abuse and neglect investigation stating that they would not bring liquids into the classroom.  Three classrooms had beverages inside the class.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Complying with Laws and Rules (26 TAC §746.201(9))

occurrences.finding: Requirements for Feeding Infants-Hold through 6-months: Staff member in infant room was observed feeding an infant a bottle that was lying on a boppy.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements for Feeding Infants-Hold through 6-months (26 TAC §746.2419(1))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: Based on information received during the investigation conducted by DFPS, it was determined that operation didn't exercise good judgement by placing a cup of hot   coffee in the reach of children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Incident/Illness Report Form Signed: Based on information received during the investigation conducted by DFPS, it was determined the incident report wasn't completed by the caregiver present at the time of the incident. The report included inaccurate information about how the incident occurred. The report also was not signed by the child's parent.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Incident/Illness Report Form Signed (26 TAC §746.705)

occurrences.finding: AP Parental Communication - Injury Requires Treatment by Health Care Professional or Hospitalization: The allegation is related to a DFPS abuse/neglect investigation. Based on information received during the investigation conducted by DFPS, it was determined that the operation staff waited 2 hours and 27 minutes to contact the parents regarding an injury that needed immediate medical attention.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Parental Communication - Injury Requires Treatment by Health Care Professional or Hospitalization (26 TAC §746.307(b)(1))

occurrences.finding: Parent right to review video recordings of alleged incident of abuse or neglect involving parent child: The allegation is related to a DFPS abuse/neglect investigation.  Based on information received during the investigation conducted by DFPS, it was determined that the parents weren't allowed access to video footage of an incident of involving neglect of their child.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Parent right to review video recordings of alleged incident of abuse or neglect involving parent child (26 TAC §746.521(8))

occurrences.finding: Director Responsibilities - Operate in Compliance: Based on the information found as part of a DFPS investigation, it is determined that the director responsibilities were not carried out when a child received a serious injury while in care. It is the director's responsibility to ensure that emergency procedures are implemented and followed to comply with minimum standards
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Responsibilities - Operate in Compliance (26 TAC §746.1003(1))

occurrences.finding: Complying with Laws and Rules: The operation isn't complying with the safety plan put in place during a current abuse and neglect investigation stating that they would not bring liquids into the classroom.  Three classrooms had beverages inside the class.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Complying with Laws and Rules (26 TAC §746.201(9))

occurrences.finding: AP Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Ensure No Child Abused, Neglected, or Exploited: This standard was found deficient as part of a DFPS Investigation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Ensure No Child Abused, Neglected, or Exploited (26 TAC §746.1201(4))

occurrences.finding: Critical Injury - Give First Aid or CPR: Based on information received during the investigation conducted by DFPS, it was determined that the first aid wasn't properly rendered when a child received a serious burn injury.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Critical Injury - Give First Aid or CPR (26 TAC §746.3607(2))

occurrences.finding: Parental Notification - Safe Sleeping Deficiency Use Form 2970: The operation still needs to provide notification to Licensing that the parents of all children enrolled at the operation have been notified regarding the safe sleep deficiency.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Parental Notification - Safe Sleeping Deficiency Use Form 2970 (26 TAC §746.311(b))

occurrences.finding: Parental Notification - Safe Sleeping Deficiency Use Form 2970: The operation didn't notify the parents of all children enrolled at the operation  within the required notification time.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Parental Notification - Safe Sleeping Deficiency Use Form 2970 (26 TAC §746.311(b))

occurrences.finding: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Use of Safety Straps: This standard was reviewed for this investigation.  Based on the information received during the investigation, a caregiver failed to properly use a restrictive device when an infant was allowed to sit in the restrictive without being fastened in with the safety straps.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Use of Safety Straps (26 TAC §746.2407)

occurrences.finding: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age: This standard was reviewed for this investigation.  Based on the information received during the investigation, an infant younger than twelve months of age was sleeping in a crib with a blanket.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age (26 TAC §746.2415(b))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records-signed dated statement that employee received child care center's personnel policies: Employee statement regarding receipt of personnel policies is needed for 1 employee.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records-signed dated statement that employee received child care center's personnel policies (26 TAC §746.901(6)(B))

occurrences.finding: Additional Minimum Qualifications for Caregivers - Age Requirement: Age/education qualification information is needed for one employee.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Additional Minimum Qualifications for Caregivers - Age Requirement (26 TAC §746.1107(1))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records- signed dated statement that employee attended abuse/neglect training: Orientation statement regarding abuse/neglect training is needed for 1 employee.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Current Driver's License (26 TAC §746.901(10))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Health Statement: 1 child in care needs a health statement for file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §746.603(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records-signed dated statement that employee received child care center's operational policies: Statement of receipt of center policies is needed for 1 employee.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records-signed dated statement that employee received child care center's operational policies (26 TAC §746.901(6)(A))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Vision and Hearing Screening: 1 child in care needs a hearing and vision screening for file.  1 child in care needs a hearing screening for file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Vision and Hearing Screening (26 TAC §746.603(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Meals: Option that the school can provide meals for the children or that parents can provide meals for their child needs to be added to the operational policies.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Meals (26 TAC §746.501(a)(10))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: Outlet cover in infant classroom is broken and needs to be replaced.  Telephone and cords are on the floor in the infant room that are accessible to children and need to be moved.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Six Inches if Equipment 5 Ft or Less: Loose-fill needs to be added to all of the playgrounds.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Six Inches if Equipment 5 Ft or Less (26 TAC §746.4907(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Hazards Removed or Repaired: The walkway is uneven and separating from the soil causing a safety risk on the outdoor play area.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Hazards Removed or Repaired (26 TAC §746.4751(c))
